description: mta_sts_error.rs: every Display arm writes write!(f, "MTA-STS: ..."). The prefix could be factored out (write!(f, "MTA-STS: ")?; then write the variant-specific text), or each arm could just format the variant detail without the prefix (the prefix is implicit in the error type name). Minor, but the current approach means changing the prefix requires editing 14 match arms.
title: Display impl for MtaStsError uses format!("MTA-STS: ...", ...) — redundant prefix in each arm
